insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput. This allows attaching multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the `orderCreate` mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This change enables more accurate tracking and fulfillment management. Ensure your app handles multiple tracking numbers correctly, and test the updated functionality thoroughly. The GraphQL Admin API will be used for this update.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, enhancing the overall shipping experience.
insight.why_it_matters: This update improves the flexibility and accuracy of order fulfillment and tracking, which is crucial for merchants and their customers.

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. Additionally, @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen have been updated with patch changes to improve local debugger connections and reliability.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. The Customer object in Shopify Functions also now includes a `createdAt` field.

themes.title: Ecosystem Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes as of August 31, 2026.
